label: Gaza dashboard
description: The overview that organizes urgent needs, signals, action pathways, trust, learning, peacebuilding, and future capacity.

label: Six sectors
description: Food, health, shelter, WASH, education, and protection/social cohesion priorities.
caveat: Sector analysis requires source and human review.

label: Live unreviewed reports
description: ReliefWeb feed enters the system as raw, unreviewed input.
caveat: Live reports do not automatically update sector analysis.

label: Source library
description: Reviewed source profiles explain what each source can help users see.

label: Knowledge Spine
description: The evidence architecture behind humanitarian, development, learning, wellbeing, and peacebuilding analysis.

label: Trust evidence
description: Transparency Passport evidence fields show public evidence and routing restrictions.

label: Methodology
description: Rules for human review, source use, safety, foresight, and public claims.
caveat: Methodology must be reviewed before public beta.

label: Advisor review
description: Expert review tracks for humanitarian, contextual, compliance, safeguarding, peacebuilding, learning, foresight, and technology review.
caveat: Advisor review is part of the product.

label: Action pathways
description: Responsible ways to donate, advocate, learn, build, partner, and support capacity.
caveat: No donation processing or unsupported routing.

label: Organizations
description: Organization profiles show evidence status, caveats, sectors, and action pathways.
caveat: Profiles do not rank or endorse organizations.

label: Learning pathways
description: Role-based pathways connect needs to competencies, resources, safeguards, and outputs.

label: Human Capacity Studio
description: Turns concern into human capacity: practices, reflection, simulations, workshops, and sustained responsible action.
caveat: Not therapy, certification, or professional advice.

label: Capacity map
description: Capacity gap hypotheses connect sectors to competencies for response and recovery.

label: Simulation Lab
description: Users practice decisions before acting in the real world.
caveat: Simulations do not replace professional or local guidance.

label: Competency Passport
description: Prototype reflection tool for learning readiness without accounts or certification.
caveat: No credentialing or saved user data.

label: Peacebuilding Lens
description: Frameworks for conflict transformation, mediation, trauma, narrative, reconciliation, systems thinking, and practical peacebuilding.

label: Social cohesion futures
description: Long-term civic, relational, youth, trust, and wellbeing capacities.

label: Deep Time Perspective
description: Reflective horizon for intergenerational responsibility.

label: Future Capacity Map
description: Time horizons, scenarios, action ripples, and systems recovery map.

label: Find My Horizon
description: Helps users locate themselves between urgent action and long-term contribution.

label: Action Ripples
description: Shows how one action can ripple through sectors, learning, trust, wellbeing, and time.

label: Workshops
description: Campus and civic learning sessions that turn platform content into responsible practice.

label: Podcast
description: Deep conversations with experts, practitioners, students, leaders, and people across communities.

label: Video explainers
description: Short explainers for trust evidence, humanitarian principles, peacebuilding, future capacity, and responsible action.

label: Partner network
description: Universities, technologists, humanitarian advisors, peacebuilders, local organizations, and funders.
